feature: Pemrosesan return file Toppan DN2 (registered mail): nomor registrasi pos disimpan ke ocms_driver_notice
note: File DPT-URA-DN2-D2-* dari Toppan diterima job download (aktif 01:30) lalu nomor registrasi pos di-PATCH ke ocms_driver_notice.postal_regn_no; service ini tidak menggeser stage VON. Tidak disebut di OCMS12.41-12.45 (hanya pengiriman surat). Story lain yang menaunginya belum dicek.
note_en: DPT-URA-DN2-D2-* files from Toppan are received by the download job (active 01:30) and the postal registration number is PATCHed into ocms_driver_notice.postal_regn_no; this service does not move the VON stage. Not mentioned in OCMS12.41-12.45 (letter sending only). Whether another story covers it has not been checked.

feature: Notice Military/Diplomatic di stage DN2/DR3 tidak dibuatkan surat, diberi PS-MID/PS-DIP otomatis
note: Pada pembuatan surat RR3/DR3, kendaraan registrasi I atau D disaring dan diberi suspension PS-MID/PS-DIP (Track 3). OCMS12.45 hanya menyebut sebagai catatan; tidak ada di teks OCMS12.41-12.45. Story lain yang menaunginya belum dicek.
note_en: When RR3/DR3 letters are generated, vehicles with registration type I or D are filtered out and given PS-MID/PS-DIP suspension (Track 3). OCMS12.45 only mentions it as a note; it is not in the text of OCMS12.41-12.45. Whether another story covers it has not been checked.

feature: TS-CLV otomatis untuk kendaraan VIP setelah surat DR3 dikirim
note: Setelah stage RR3/DR3 diproses, applyClvSuspensionForVipVehicles menerapkan TS-CLV untuk kendaraan VIP (OCMS 17). Bukan bagian teks OCMS12.45; story VIP (mis. OCMS14.x) yang menaunginya belum dicek.
note_en: After stage RR3/DR3 is processed, applyClvSuspensionForVipVehicles applies TS-CLV to VIP vehicles (OCMS 17). Not part of the OCMS12.45 text; the VIP story (e.g. OCMS14.x) that covers it has not been checked.
